name: chat
title: Chat
description: A composable chat interface: scrollable message thread with received/sent bubbles, short pills, dividers, and a batteries-included message input. Composes the Avatar and Button components. Uses namespace exports: Chat.Root, Chat.List, Chat.Message, Chat.Avatar, Chat.Bubble, Chat.Timestamp, Chat.Divider, Chat.Input, Chat.SendButton.

docs.lead: A composable chat interface with a scrollable, auto-scrolling message thread and a configurable message input. Composes the Avatar and Button components. Bring your own message data; override any part as needed.
docs.usage:
import * as Chat from "@/components/ui/chat"

<Chat.Root>
  <Chat.List>
    <Chat.Message side="received" avatar={<Chat.Avatar src="/avatar.png" />}>
      <Chat.Bubble>
        Hello there!
        <Chat.Timestamp>3:00 PM</Chat.Timestamp>
      </Chat.Bubble>
    </Chat.Message>
  </Chat.List>
  <Chat.Input onSend={(text) => send(text)} />
</Chat.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A full thread with received and sent bubbles, short pills, and date / new-message dividers. Set a height on a parent so the list can scroll.
examples.code: Join us for an engaging seminar… 3:00 PM Explore the fundamentals… 3:00 PM 23 May, 2025 Hey! 3:00 PM New message send(text)} />

examples.title: Bubbles
examples.description: Sent, received, and highlighted bubble tones. The tone defaults from the parent Message's side and can be overridden.
examples.code:
<Chat.Message side="received" avatar={avatar}>
  <Chat.Bubble>
    A received message.
    <Chat.Timestamp>3:00 PM</Chat.Timestamp>
  </Chat.Bubble>
</Chat.Message>
<Chat.Message side="sent" avatar={avatar}>
  <Chat.Bubble>
    A sent message.
    <Chat.Timestamp>3:00 PM</Chat.Timestamp>
  </Chat.Bubble>
</Chat.Message>
<Chat.Message side="received">
  <Chat.Bubble tone="highlight">
    A highlighted message.
    <Chat.Timestamp>3:00 PM</Chat.Timestamp>
  </Chat.Bubble>
</Chat.Message>

examples.title: Pills and Dividers
examples.description: Short pill-shaped messages and both divider variants (date and highlighted new-message).
examples.code:
<Chat.Message side="received">
  <Chat.Bubble shape="pill">
    Hey!
    <Chat.Timestamp>3:00 PM</Chat.Timestamp>
  </Chat.Bubble>
</Chat.Message>
<Chat.Divider>23 May, 2025</Chat.Divider>
<Chat.Divider variant="feature">New message</Chat.Divider>

examples.title: Input
examples.description: The default input: attachment + emoji buttons, an auto-growing field, and a send button. Uncontrolled by default; Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline.

examples.title: Interactive
examples.description: A live thread that appends messages on send. The list sticks to the bottom as new messages arrive.
examples.code:
const [messages, setMessages] = React.useState([])

<Chat.Root>
  <Chat.List>
    {messages.map((m) => (
      <Chat.Message key={m.id} side={m.side} avatar={m.avatar}>
        <Chat.Bubble>
          {m.text}
          <Chat.Timestamp>Now</Chat.Timestamp>
        </Chat.Bubble>
      </Chat.Message>
    ))}
  </Chat.List>
  <Chat.Input onSend={(text) => setMessages((p) => [...p, { id: p.length + 1, side: 'sent', text }])} />
</Chat.Root>

examples.title: Custom Input
examples.description: Override the default input clusters with the leading / actions slots. Chat.SendButton forwards Button props, so restyling is just variant/mode.
examples.code:
<Chat.Input
  placeholder="Ask anything…"
  showAttachment={false}
  actions={<Chat.SendButton variant="primary" mode="filled" />}
  onSend={(text) => send(text)}
/>

api.name: Chat.Root
api.description: Vertical layout container. Fills its parent and pins the input 20px below the list. Set a height on it (or its parent) so the list can scroll.

api.name: Chat.List
api.description: Scrollable message container. Auto-scrolls to the newest message when the user is near the bottom.

props.name: autoScroll
props.description: Stick to the bottom as new messages arrive (unless the user has scrolled up)

api.name: Chat.Message
api.description: A single message row. Reserves a 44px gutter on both sides so avatar-less rows stay aligned with rows that have an avatar.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side the message is on. Drives alignment and the default bubble tone.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Optional avatar rendered in the gutter on the message's side (e.g. <Chat.Avatar src="…" />)

props.name: animateIn
props.description: Play the entrance animation on mount. By default the List works this out from the message keys: a message added to a list that was already showing messages animates, while a batch (the first render, a fetch resolving, a conversation swapped in) does not.

api.name: Chat.Avatar
api.description: Thin wrapper around the Avatar component, sized for chat rows (32px). Pass `src` for the common case, or compose Avatar parts as children. Forwards all Avatar.Root props (size, color, etc.).

props.name: src
props.description: Image source. Renders an Avatar.Image when provided.

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar size token (forwarded to Avatar.Root)

api.name: Chat.Bubble
api.description: The message bubble. Reads side from the parent Message to pick a default tone.

props.name: shape
props.description: Rounded card ('bubble') or content-hugging pill ('pill') for short messages

props.name: tone
props.description: Color tone. Defaults from the parent Message's side (sent → sent, otherwise received).

api.name: Chat.Timestamp
api.description: Small caption inside a bubble. Adapts its color and position to the surrounding bubble.

api.name: Chat.Divider
api.description: A centered label between two rules, e.g. a date or a new-message marker.

props.name: variant
props.description: Neutral date label ('default') or highlighted primary label ('feature')

api.name: Chat.Input
api.description: Batteries-included composer. Uncontrolled by default; pass value/onChange to control it. Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Fired when the user sends (Enter or the send button). Receives the trimmed text.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Omit for uncontrolled behavior.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired on every keystroke

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Click handler for the default attachment button

props.name: onEmoji
props.description: Click handler for the default emoji button

props.name: showAttachment
props.description: Show the attachment button

props.name: showEmoji
props.description: Show the emoji button

props.name: leading
props.description: Replace the left (attachment) cluster entirely

props.name: actions
props.description: Replace the right (emoji + send) cluster entirely

props.name: sendDisabled
props.description: Disable sending even when there is text

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max auto-grow height in px before the field scrolls

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the input container

api.name: Chat.SendButton
api.description: The send button, built on the Button component (neutral / lighter by default). Renders an arrow-up icon unless given children, and forwards all Button.Root props (variant, mode, loading, etc.).
